name: trueforge-vscode-agent
description: A coding agent for VS Code whose agent loop runs on TrueForge (Techfest 2026-27 Forge-a-thon)

trueforgeAgent.baseUrl.description: Base URL of your local TrueForge server (npx @truefoundry/trueforge@latest).

trueforgeAgent.token.description: Bearer token, only needed if TrueForge OIDC login is enabled. Leave blank for local standalone mode.

trueforgeAgent.primaryModel.description: Model name exactly as listed by TrueForge (Settings -> Models or GET /api/v1/models), e.g. 'openai/gpt-5-4-mini'.

trueforgeAgent.fallbackModel.description: Second model name for automatic fallback (Task C resilience). Leave blank to disable fallback.

trueforgeAgent.mcpServerPort.description: Preferred local port for this extension's MCP tool server (falls back to a free port if taken). The extension registers it with TrueForge automatically.

trueforgeAgent.contextTokenBudget.description: Token budget for context the editor assembles before a turn (@file / @symbol mentions + automatic retrieval).

trueforgeAgent.maxRetries.description: Retries (with exponential backoff) against the primary model before falling back to the fallback model.

trueforgeAgent.stallTimeoutSeconds.description: If TrueForge sends no event for this long (while not waiting on your review), the attempt is treated as failed and retried/fallen back.

scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
